name: Extension Reference
description: A field type that references installed extensions (modules/themes).
project_description:
This module provides a new field type to select a theme, a module or a installation profile to be referenced into a content entity.

 Extension reference fields can be used to link content entities to extensions. Here are some possible use cases:

 
 Custom theme switching 
 Extension shop 
 Site instance shop, associating commerce products with installation profiles 
 
 For now the module just list all the extensions using a select box, but it is planned to improve it by supporting some filtering on settable options.
